x: At the halfway stage Arthur Penny and Vic Blowfield were running together with the rest of the field strung out in this order—Pearson, Frost, Eales, Tobin, Stokell.
Stokell, now back down South once again, came next with Ted Stimpson, R.

Les Stokell won the individual race with Syd Ring third and Bert Footer fourth. Bert was running for our “ B ” team, otherwise we should have scored a hollow win in the team race but even so we still came out winners and Syd Ring also took 2nd prize in the individual handicap race.

Jack Brown, the holder, was a non-starter, but a small bunch of runners soon detached themselves from the rest of the field with Lucas, Herbert, Tooby, Bromley, Stokell, Bruce and Stearman more or less together.
Our "B" team of—Newell, Adams, Short and Bedford, all ran well to finish in 3rd position in front of Cambridge H., Reading A.C., and Surrey A.C., with our "C" team—Stokell, Taylor, E.
